# Carrot Fertility Investigation: September 2021 – July 2022 Tenure Window

### Overview & Timeframe
* **Target Window**: September 1, 2021 – July 31, 2022 (`from=20210901` to `to=20220731`)
* **Primary Domains**: `get-carrot.com` and `carrotfertility.com`
* **Key Finding on Webflow**: During this exact timeframe, Carrot Fertility relied heavily on **Webflow Enterprise** as their primary marketing CMS engine. Webflow powered the main website, modular Webflow templates, content collections, and campaign landing pages. This infrastructure earned Carrot Fertility the **Webflow Award (All Star Category) at Webflow Conf 2023** for their Webflow brand transformation and marketing velocity.

---

## Breakdown by Domain and Subdomain

### 1. `www.get-carrot.com` / `get-carrot.com` (Main Marketing Site & CMS)

* **Platform / CMS**: **Webflow Enterprise CMS**
* **Site Architecture & Hierarchy**:
  * **L0**: Homepage (`/`)
  * **L1 Solutions (B2B)**: `/employers`, `/health-plans`, `/consultants`, `/unions`
  * **L1 Member Care**: `/members` (featuring Carrot Card® reimbursement, care navigation, and the *At-Home Female Fertility & Wellness Test* launched in Dec 2021)
  * **L1 Content & Resources**: `/resources`, `/blog`, `/press`
  * **L1 Company**: `/about`, `/careers`, `/contact`
* **Webflow CMS Collections & Post Types**:
  * **Blog Post Collection (`/blog`, `/blog/{slug}`)**: Categorized by clinical insights, workplace benefit strategies, inclusivity/LGBTQ+ care, men's health/Low T, and menopause/midlife care.
  * **Resource Center Collection (`/resources`)**: Gated whitepaper reports (e.g., *Fertility at Work 2021*, *Menopause in the Workplace 2022*), webinars, and downloadable guides.
  * **Case Studies Collection (`/resources/case-studies/{slug}`)**: Customer success stories highlighting employer retention and health plan ROI.
  * **Press Release Collection (`/press`, `/press/{slug}`)**: Announcements including the $75M Series C funding (Oct 2021) and partnership integrations.
  * **Careers Collection (`/careers`, `/careers/{job-slug}`)**: Open role listings, team spotlights, and benefit highlights.
* **Tech Stack & Libraries**:
  * **Frontend Engine**: Webflow JS (`webflow.js`), jQuery (Webflow animation runner), core-js polyfills.
  * **CSS Framework**: Webflow CSS custom design system (flexbox/grid, responsive breakpoints, custom utility classes).
  * **Analytics & Tracking**: Google Tag Manager (`GTM-XXXX`), Google Analytics (UA/GA4), Segment (`analytics.js`), LinkedIn Insight Tag, Meta/Facebook Pixel.
  * **Forms**: Webflow Native Forms connected to HubSpot / Marketo APIs.

---

### 2. `go.get-carrot.com` / `go.carrotfertility.com` / `info.get-carrot.com` (Demand Gen & Campaign Subdomains)

* **Platform / CMS**: **Webflow Templates & Landing Page Builder** integrated with **Marketo / HubSpot**.
* **Purpose & Usage**:
  * Standalone, high-converting B2B campaign landing pages for paid search (Google Ads), social ads (LinkedIn/Meta), and HR conference campaigns.
  * Built using **modular Webflow templates** (reusable section components: Hero headers, form embeds, feature grids, social proof testimonials, trust badges).
  * Gated download pages for flagship research reports (*Menopause in the Workplace 2022* report, *Fertility at Work 2021* survey).
* **Tech Stack & Libraries**:
  * **Template Architecture**: Modular Webflow component templates.
  * **Lead Capture & Marketing Automation**: Embedded Marketo Forms (`munchkin.js`) / HubSpot Form APIs (`hs-scripts`).
  * **Tracking Pixels**: GTM, Segment, LinkedIn Insight Tag, Google Ads Conversion Tracking, Facebook Pixel.

---

### 3. `app.carrotfertility.com` / `auth.carrotfertility.com` (Member Web App)

* **Platform / CMS**: Custom **React.js** Single-Page Application (SPA) on **AWS** (*Not Webflow; secure HIPAA-compliant web portal*).
* **Purpose**:
  * Member authentication, onboarding, and plan enrollment.
  * Carrot Card® financial transaction management and expense reimbursements.
  * Telehealth consultations, care navigation, and ordering at-home testing kits.
* **Tech Stack & Libraries**:
  * **Frontend**: React, React-DOM, TypeScript.
  * **Backend & Cloud**: AWS (S3, CloudFront CDN, AWS Lambda), C# / .NET Core APIs.
  * **Analytics**: Segment CDP, Mixpanel / Amplitude product analytics.

---

### 4. `help.carrotfertility.com` / `resources.get-carrot.com` (Help & Support Center)

* **Platform / CMS**: Support Knowledge Base (Zendesk / Webflow Support Template).
* **Purpose**: FAQs, member support guides, employer benefit setup documentation.

---

## Summary of Webflow Template Work (Sept 2021 – July 2022)
During the Sept 2021 – July 2022 window, Carrot Fertility's digital marketing operation was driven by **Webflow Enterprise**. The creation of **Webflow templates** allowed marketing and design teams to rapidly launch modular landing pages (`go.get-carrot.com`), iterate on CMS post layouts (`/blog` and `/resources`), and publish research campaign assets. This design system infrastructure laid the foundation for Carrot Fertility winning the **Webflow Award at Webflow Conf 2023**.
